title: npm repository settings
description: The npm member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

latestGuard.title: Guard the latest tag
latestGuard.description: A publish of a version below latest, or of a pre-release while latest is a release, is stored without moving latest. Turn it off if every publish under latest should move it.

serveRemovedVersions.title: Serve removed versions
serveRemovedVersions.description: Keep serving cached versions and packages that the upstream has removed, to exact downloads such as from a lockfile; they are no longer listed. Leave it off so that what the upstream took down, often malware, stops being served.

latestStrategy.title: Latest tag strategy
latestStrategy.description: Which latest tag this virtual repository offers when the latest tags of its members differ.

distTagStrategy.title: Dist-tag strategy
distTagStrategy.description: Which value the other dist-tags, such as next or beta, take when the values of the members differ.

audit.title: Security audit
audit.description: How npm audit, pnpm audit and yarn npm audit are answered for this repository.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Automatic answers from trove's advisory data while vulnerability scanning is on, and otherwise forwards on a remote or virtual repository and is off on a local one. Forwarding sends only the names of public packages a remote has already fetched, never internal ones.

providerURL.title: Provider URL
providerURL.description: Only when forwarding: the registry that answers the audits; leave it empty to ask the upstream. It receives the upstream credential only if its host is the upstream's or a further host that receives the credential.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Only when forwarding: how long to wait for the answer, 1 to 300 seconds, written like 30s.

maxBodySize.title: Largest audit request
maxBodySize.description: The largest audit request trove accepts, 1 KiB to 10 MiB, written like 1MiB. Raise it if the audits of very large projects are refused.
